benchmark_candidate: SDD YNet short-horizon TrajNet-compatible pedestrian task

data.raw_video_fps_evidence: YNet official preprocessing docstring; original video metadata not acquired
data.timebase_rule: 12 original frames / verified 30fps = .4s; do not freeze until original timing/source checked
data.window_stride_status: proposed nonoverlap 20, not asserted official short-term stride
data.downsample_anchor: per contiguous track segment start, source YNet row-step sampler; stable frame support must be recorded
data.reference_transform: per-video explicit scale matrix and optional right/bottom zero padding
data.context_classes: none in standard YNet; PECNet social context audited separately
data.lost: exclude lost=1 then split temporal gaps before sampling
data.occluded: retain author-style annotated positions with explicit occluded flag; no fabricated coordinates
data.generated: retain raw interpolated annotations with flag; report coverage, not call all rows human-keyframed
data.target_eligibility: complete 8+12 exact sampled frames, same source/video/person; labels only in supervision
data.out_of_image_target_policy: UNRESOLVED: audit first; do not silently clip/remove hard targets
data.original_header_policy: headerless parser; author header=0 drops first row, adaptation must be declared

splits.reference: YNet author data/SDD/{train,test}_trajnet.pkl and image directories
splits.requirement: Recover official train/test identity lists; derive or adopt documented validation using source-train ONLY before metrics; no test selection
splits.duplicate_window_check: source/video/person plus full sampled frame support and history/GT SHA
splits.background_site_overlap: UNVERIFIED until exact manifest; video isolation not unseen-site generalization

semantics.obstacle_class_rule: UNRESOLVED until genuine label definitions; no blanket grass/road/tree prohibition

evaluation.TTST_CWS: must freeze original config and 10000 proposal/20-output computation budget before comparison
evaluation.ADE: mean over12 Euclidean trajectory point distances, raw pixels
evaluation.FDE: actual predicted path step12 distance to GT step12
evaluation.minADE_K: independent min of complete candidate ADE values
evaluation.minFDE_K: independent min of actual path endpoint errors
evaluation.GoalFDE: predicted or sampled goal vs GT endpoint; separate from actual trajectory FDE
evaluation.Endpoint_ADE_note: for one endpoint time, average distance equals EndpointFDE; not a distinct trajectory ADE
evaluation.author_YNet_FDE: official test.py uses waypoint goal endpoint, not necessarily decoded trajectory final point
evaluation.author_PECNet_ADE: official evaluator selects best endpoint using GT before decoding one path; not independent minADE across K full paths
evaluation.coordinate_unscale: reverse only declared resize/normalization; no approximate scales called precise meters
evaluation.overlaps: cluster/report repeated windows per source-person, no iid significance

scene_compliance.outside: separate failure category, never silently clip to border
scene_compliance.boundaries: predeclare one raw-pixel uncertainty band before metrics; report boundary separately
scene_compliance.all_candidates: mean violation fraction and at-least-one-compliant coverage at fixed K
scene_compliance.oracle: GT-selected accuracy or compliant min errors explicitly oracle, never online selection

control_warning: YNet vs PECNet published scores change architecture, modalities and sampling; no module attribution. Same backbone/target/head/budget adaptations need separate approval
blocking_conditions: major recent methods lack full-text audit
full pipeline compatibility and full epoch cost unknown
